description: How pages target a keyword. Pick with mode: focus = One page against one keyword: 8 checks. Needs url, keyword. cannibalization = Your pages competing for one keyword, side by side on every signal, with the plan. Needs keyword, target_url.

competing_urls.description: Other pages of the same site that compete for the keyword.

keyword.description: The search term the page should rank for, for example 'running shoes'.

rows.description: Optional Search Console rows for the keyword, to find the competing pages and their positions.

target_url.description: The page that should rank for it.

url.description: Full address of the page, for example https://example.com/pricing.

title: Keyword targeting
